name: Student Living - Edge Apartments
about:
Student Living - Edge Apartments are different from regular student accommodation in Adelaide. Rather than being housed on one site, they’re strategically placed throughout central Adelaide at five locations close to colleges and universities.
Our Adelaide serviced apartments offer a range of accommodation options including three-bedroom townhouses to share with other residents and two-bedroom apartments for more privacy. The townhouses typically comprise of a single lockup garage, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, laundry, kitchen, living and dining room and under-stair storage areas. The two-bedroom apartments feature two large bedrooms, well-equipped kitchens and balconies.
Some of the Townhouses are also located adjacent to the Adelaide Central Market, the popular China Town, the Adelaide TAFE College and the Royal Adelaide Hospital. Locations include Cypress Street, Gray Street, Grote Street, Queens Court, and Synagogue Place. All of the buildings are self-contained and fully furnished.
